entries.text: 希# rare + 禾 grain/rice → *scarce*/*rare* crops (= poor harvest; compare 飢 and 饑) → *thin/slight* (← slight quantity).
䟽也。从禾希聲。
As per 良# (flowing stream) + 禾 grain/rice → type of *weed* or *wild grass*, originally referring to water plants with long, flowing roots; compare 莨.
𥢶也。从禾孚聲。
租也。从禾兌聲。
旱# dry up + 禾 grain/rice → *dried up stalk* of a grain plant → *straw*.
禾莖也。从禾旱聲。《春秋傳》曰：“或投一秉稈。”
As per 弟# (vertical alignment) + 禾 grain/rice → Echinochloa crus-galli, a type of wild grass, the spikelets of which hang low.

As per 呈# (extend) + 禾 grain/rice → extensive ears of grain → *standard* length (of plants) → *extent*; *distance*; *measure*; *limit*; *certain degree of time*; *about*; *to the point/extent that* (← standard length).
品也。十髮爲程，十程爲分，十分爲寸。从禾呈聲。
稻也。从禾余聲。《周禮》曰：“牛宜稌。”
As per 肖# (resemble in miniature) + 禾 grain/rice → small ears of crops → *slight*; *a little bit*. Also, *gradually* (← bit by bit).
出物有漸也。从禾肖聲。
As per 兌# (strip away) + 禾 grain/rice → strip away part of a harvest as a *tithe*/*tax* (compare 租) → *tear away*; *collect*; *exact*; *take out*; *release*.
疾孰也。从禾坴聲。《詩》曰：“黍稷種稑。”
As per 念# (contain) + 禾 grain/rice → ripening of grain contained in a husk → *ripen* (compare 莟) → *harvest*. Also, *year* (← harvest as completion of a cycle; compare 年 and 歳).
穀孰也。从禾念聲。《春秋傳》曰：“鮮不五稔。”
束稈也。从禾𦎫聲。
卑# low + 禾 grain/rice → a *barnyard grass*, shorter than rice plants and with smaller grains → *small*.
禾別也。从禾卑聲。琅邪有稗縣。
As per 其# (square/rectangular) + 禾 grain/rice → one full agricultural cycle → *one cycle*; *a full month*; *a full year*. Compare 期 as well as 季 and 週.
復其時也。从禾其聲。《虞書》曰：“稘三百有六旬。”
直# straight + 禾 grain/rice → the straight stalks of an *early-ripening variety of rice*.
早穜也。从禾直聲。《詩》曰：“稙稚尗麥。”
穉 is as per 犀# (slow) + 禾 grain/rice → late-developing grain → *young* (child); *infant* (← slow-developing creature). 穉 has been supplanted by the form 稚.
As per 囷#: *bundle* grain → *bind*. 禾 was added to devise a replacement character for 囷 after 囷 came to be used to indicate a granary.
絭束也。从禾囷聲。
Effectively a variant form of 棱 (*angle*; *edge*; *corner*), with 禾 replacing 木.
穀之善者。从禾果聲。一曰無皮穀。

The top element# is a granary (compare 亶). 稟 adds 禾 grain/rice → *granary* in which rows of harvested crops are stored (compare 厤 as described in 曆) → *conferral*; *grant*; *salary* (← grain conferred as payment; compare 料). Also, *receive a request for (and offer one's opinion)* (to a superior) (← have a request conferred on one by one's superior, considered an honor). A variant form, 禀, replaces 禾 with 示 altar/the supernatural.
賜穀也。从㐭从禾。

As per 周# (grain plants) + 禾 grain/rice → thick growth or great quantity of grain plants → *grow thick*; *great quantity*; *density*. 稠 was devised to replace 周 after 周 acquired its extended meanings.
多也。从禾周聲。
沛國謂稻曰稬。从禾耎聲。
As per 皆# (line up) + 禾 grain/rice → aligned *stalks* of dehusked grain plants.
禾稾去其皮，祭天以爲席。从禾皆聲。

As per 重# (run through) + 禾 grain/rice → run seeds/saplings through soil in planting → *seed* → *type*; *kind*; *sort*; *species* (← seed as the type of the plant it will become) → *cause*; *source*. Other extended meanings include (source) *material*, *ingredients*, *breed*, *topic* and (magician's) *trick*.
先穜後孰也。从禾重聲。
布之八十縷爲稯。从禾㚇聲。

爯# combines an abbreviated form of 再 (symmetry) + 爪 (pick/pluck) → pick up/raise an object in weighing it on a balance (compare 耑). 稱 adds 禾 grain/rice → raise crops in order to weigh them. *Name* is a borrowed meaning.
銓也。从禾爯聲。春分而禾生。日夏至，晷景可度。禾有秒，秋分而秒定。律數：十二秒而當一分，十分而寸。其以爲重：十二粟爲一分，十二分爲一銖。故諸程品皆从禾。
稻不黏者。从禾兼聲。讀若風廉之廉。
As per 畟# (pile) + 禾 grain/rice → piles of grain → *millet*. 稷 also has been used as a reference to a grain deity; note a variant form 禝 with 示 altar/the supernatural replacing 禾.
𪗉也。五穀之長。从禾畟聲。
穜穊也。从禾眞聲。《周禮》曰：“稹理而堅。”
幼禾也。从禾屖聲。
舀# ladle + 禾 grain/rice → *rice plant* likened in shape to a ladle.
稌也。从禾舀聲。
As per 家# (hut/shed) + 禾 grain/rice → *harvested crops* in a storehouse → *plant crops*; *earn a living*; *work* → *gain* (← work).
禾之秀實爲稼，莖節爲禾。从禾家聲。一曰稼，家事也。一曰在野曰稼。

Originally, the right-hand element# was 耆 (preserved food). The addition of 禾 grain/rice suggested the inspection of preserved crops → *consider*; *compare* (← consider/compare in inspecting). Also, *stay*; *remain*; *retain*; *keep* (← preserved).
畱止也。从𥝌从尤，旨聲。凡稽之屬皆从稽。
稈也。从禾高聲。
禾 grain/rice + 高# high/tall → tall stalks of millet → straw → *draft*; *manuscript* (raw version of a written work ← raw material ← millet stalks used as thatch or fuel).
An abbreviated form# of 殼 (husk) + 禾 grain/rice (for emphasis/clarification of the husk of a grain plant) → *grain* → *cereal*.
續也。百穀之緫名。从禾𣪊聲。

穀.example: 山谷 → 山谷; 五谷 → 五穀

entries.text: 𪎭也。从禾祭聲。
榖皮也。从禾从米，庚聲。

The right-hand element# combines 彡 pattern + an abbreviated form of the right-hand element of 隙 (faint light spreading through small fissures) → faint pattern. 穆 adds 禾 grain/rice → *quiet*/*calm* of a grain field with crops planted at regular intervals → *gentle*; *reverent*; *respectful* (← behavior of a quiet/calm individual).
禾也。从禾㣎聲。
稠也。从禾旣聲。

魚# fish + 禾 grain/rice → life forms that continually *rise anew* (i.e., no matter how many fish are caught or crops harvested, more appear in the next fishing/harvest season) → *revive/be revived* (this meaning influenced by 甦) → *be resuscitated*; *be reborn*.
把取禾若也。从禾魚聲。
As per 責# (pile) + 禾 grain/rice → pile crops → *pile/heap up*; *load*; *accumulate* → *area*; *bulk*; *store*; *save*; *savings* → *intention*; *expectation*; *estimation* (← accumulation of ideas).
聚也。从禾責聲。
As per 頃# (incline) + 禾 grain/rice → sharp ears/spikes of a grain plant, inclining on account of their weight → *outstanding* (← sharp).
禾末也。从禾頃聲。《詩》曰：“禾穎穟穟。”
禾穖也。从禾幾聲。

惠# benefaction + 禾 grain/rice → heavy *ears/heads* of grain (a benefaction of the heavens). *Crest* (of a wave) and *point* (of a spear/writing brush) are via association with the tips of the ears of grain plants.
As per 童# (run through) + 禾 grain/rice → *plant grain seed* (← thrust into the earth) → (variety of late-ripening) *rice*.
埶也。从禾童聲。
禾𥝩之皃。从禾遂聲。《詩》曰：“禾穎穟穟。”
As per 農# (soft and sticky) + 禾 grain/rice → sticky, luxuriant *vegetation*.
As per 嗇# (grain piled in a granary) + 禾 grain/rice → *place harvested grain in a granary*; *grain awaiting placement in a granary* → *agricultural work*.
As per 歳# (harvest) + 禾 grain/rice → *be in disorder* (← post-harvest leavings) → *dirty*; *filthy*. Compare 濊.
穫刈也。一曰撮也。从禾齊聲。
As per 㥯# as described in 隱 (conceal) + 禾 grain/rice → conceal and reserve a supply of harvested crops → *calm*; *quiet*; *peaceful* (← conceal one's volatile feelings from others) → *moderate*.
蹂榖聚也。一曰安也。从禾，隱省。古通用安隱。
A variant form# of 矍 (enclose in the hands) + 禾 grain/rice → enclose grain in the hands in harvesting → *harvest*.
刈穀也。从禾蒦聲。

entries.text: 芒粟也。从禾廣聲。
耕禾閒也。从禾麃聲。《春秋傳》曰：“是穮是衮。”
As per 襄# (supple/soft) + 禾 grain/rice → pliant, stripped *stalks of millet* → *rich harvest of grain* → *abundant*.
黍𥟜已治者。从禾襄聲。
宀 roof/building + 八# split right and left → remove dirt in digging a *hole* for a cave dwelling.
土室也。从宀八聲。凡穴之屬皆从穴。
空大也。从穴乙聲。

As per 九# (bump up against and bend/curve) + 穴 hole → fumble about in the far reaches of a hole in seeking something (compare 探) → *investigate*; *research* (compare 考) → *master* (a discipline). Compare also 奧.
窮也。从穴九聲。
窀穸也。从穴夕聲。
弓# bow + 穴 hole → *tent*, or the *sky* (stretching over empty space like a bow) → *arch*; *the wide heavens* → *arch-shaped object*.
窮也。从穴弓聲。
As per 工# (connecting pipe/tube) + 穴 hole → *empty* *space* inside a connecting pipe/tube → *vacant* → *sky*; *the air*; → *absent-minded*; *pretend* (← no substance).
竅也。从穴工聲。
井# well + 穴 hole → *pit* in which to *trap* animals.

穴# hole + 牙 fangs/mesh → using fangs, pierce a hole → *make a hole*; *dig*; *drill* → *pass through*; *pass an object through*; *penetration*; *investigate thoroughly*. Also, *wear/put on* (footwear) (← foot that penetrates the hole of footwear). For the idea of piercing, compare 串 and 丱.
通也。从牙在穴中。
葬之厚夕。从穴屯聲。《春秋傳》曰：“窀穸从先君於地下。”

穴# hole + 犬 dog/beast → hole from which a dog/beast suddenly springs → *thrust*; *protrude*; *frontal assault*; *attack*; *sudden* → *stab*; *prick*; *pierce*; *strike*; *push* → *push through*. For "protrusion," compare 凸and 出.
犬从穴中暫出也。从犬在穴中。一曰滑也。
As per 乍# (pile) + 穴 hole → create a *narrow* opening in a pile → *make narrow*.
目# eye + 穴 hole → *eyes sunk deep in a person's eye sockets* → *deep*. Compare 眶.
深目也。从穴中目。
Abbreviated form# of 泛 cover + 穴 hole → *place a coffin in a grave*.
葬下棺也。从穴乏聲。《周禮》曰：“及窆執斧。”
幼 here a variant form# of the doubled 幺 element described in 幽 (obscure) + 穴 hole → obscure recesses → *quiet*; *secluded* (← quiet, secluded recesses) → *refined* (← quiet elegance).
深遠也。从穴幼聲。
污衺，下也。从穴瓜聲。
物在穴中皃。从穴中出。
窖也。从穴卯聲。
甑空也。从穴圭聲。
至# stopping point + 穴 hole → stopping point in a cavern, where further progress is impossible (compare 室) → *block*; *obstruct*. *Nitrogen* is via the compound 窒素.
塞也。从穴至聲。

The variant form 窗 is the original form: 穴 hole + 囱# a compressed stream of smoke escaping a ventilation hole (compare 向) → *window*. 窓 is a variant form of 窻, which is 穴 hole + 悤, an obsolete character indicating agitation (likened to the heart being compressed).
䆞窔，深也。从穴交聲。
As per 兆# (split) + 穴 hole → follow a winding cavern (= split in the earth) to its depths (compare 岫 and 邃) → *deep* → *profound*. *Slender*, *graceful* and *elegant* are borrowed meanings via 姚.
深肆極也。从穴兆聲。讀若挑。
As per 告# (bend) + 穴 hole → *cavern* (with a low ceiling, forcing one to bend) → *cellar*.
地藏也。从穴告聲。
As per 君# (group) + 穴 hole → group of people falling into a hole → *be in trouble*; *be at a loss*. Also, *rebuke* (← place someone in a figurative hole).
迫也。从穴君聲。
坎中小坎也。从穴从臽，臽亦聲。《易》曰：“入于坎窞。”一曰㫄入也。
屈# bend + 穴 hole → bend to enter a *cavern* or *cave*.
穴# hole + 巣 nest → *nest* made in a deep *hole/cavity* → *den*. Compare 窩.
空也。穴中曰窠，樹上曰巢。从穴果聲。
穴中見也。从穴叕聲。
从穴中卒出。从穴卒聲。
地室。从穴音聲。
咼# (variant of 冎 round or rounded cavity) + 穴 hole → rounded *cave*, lair or den → *nest* (compare 窠); *hide*.
As per 洼# (water collecting in a cone-shaped hollow) + 穴 hole (for emphasis/clarification) → a *hollow/depression* → *low place*.
兪# remove + 穴 hole → *bore a hole*. Also, a *small door* standing beside a large gate.
穿木戶也。从穴俞聲。一曰空中也。

As per 躬# (bend) + 穴 hole → bend in negotiating a tunnel → *be blocked/stuffed*; *be at/come to an extreme*; *end*; *dead end* (← reach the end of a tunnel). Also the borrowed meanings *investigation* and *follow through* (compare 究, 奧, and 探).
As per 羔# (fit into a pot) + 穴 hole → *kiln* (into which kneaded clay is inserted) → *oven*.
燒瓦竈也。从穴羔聲。
杳窱也。从穴條聲。
污窬也。从穴㼌聲。朔方有窳渾縣。
塞也。从穴眞聲。
窵窅，深也。从穴鳥聲。
As per 婁# (continuum) + 穴 hole → be permanently confined in a narrow space → *poor* → *shabby*; *wretched*. Compare 陋.
As per 規# (observe) + 穴 hole → observe through a hole → *peep through/into*; *spy (on)*; *watch for*.
小視也。从穴規聲。
通孔也。从穴怱聲。
As per 隆# (wind upward) + 穴 hole → ventilation hole in a ceiling allowing the release of rising smoke (compare 向) → *arch*; *dome*.
正視也。从穴中正見也，正亦聲。
穿地也。从穴毳聲。一曰小鼠。《周禮》曰：“大喪，甫竁。”
穿也。从穴尞聲。《論語》有公伯竂。

穴 here an abbreviated form# of 穿 (pierce a hole) + 鼠 rat/mouse → rat/mouse piercing a hole and fleeing → *flee* (and *conceal* oneself) → *expel*; *drive off/out*. *Rewrite*, *rework* and *edit* are borrowed meanings.
匿也。从鼠在穴中。
As per 敫# as described in 激 (collide and scatter) + 穴 hole → *hole/cavern* created by water colliding with earth/rock → (small) *aperture*.
空也。从穴敫聲。
極也。从穴躳聲。

As per 𧶠# as described in 續 (pass along) + 穴 hole → hole, burrow or aperture allowing passage → *cellar* at the end of a subterranean passage → *side door*; *small door* (← small side door leading to a cellar).
空也。从穴，瀆省聲。
An abbreviated form# of 窯 oven + 黽 frog/amphibious creature (here, a shape indicator) → heavy earthen *hearth/furnace* → *cooking stove*.
炊竈也。从穴，鼀省聲。

Originally 穴# hole + an element combining 米 rice and a variant of 廾 pair of hands → insect that darts into a hole and consumes rice stealthily → *steal*. Over time, 米 was replaced by the similar 釆 scattered seeds, while the pair of hands element was dropped.
The relevant oracle bone form of this character shows a standing figure who exerts continuous downward pressure on the ground → *stand* → *arise*; *raise*; *erect*.
住也。从大立一之上。凡立之屬皆从立。
立 (ON reading: リツ) for the sound of リ(ッ) as an abbreviated transliteration of "liter" ( リットル) + 十 ten → one *decaliter*.
立 (ON reading: リツ) for the sound of リ(ッ) as an abbreviated transliteration of "liter" ( リットル) + 千 one thousand → one *kiloliter*.

立 (ON reading: リツ) for the sound of リ(ッ) as an abbreviated transliteration of "liter" ( リットル) + 毛. In the 尺貫法 （シャッカンホウ） measuring system Japan inherited from China 毫 (often abbreviated as 毛) represented 1/1000 of a unit, so the combination of elements here creates the meaning one *milliliter*.

立 (ON reading: リツ) for the sound of リ(ッ) as an abbreviated transliteration of "liter" ( リットル) + 分. In the 尺貫法 （シャッカンホウ） measuring system Japan inherited from China 分 represented 1/10 of a unit, so the combination of elements here creates the meaning one *deciliter*.
健也。一曰匠也。从立句聲。讀若齲。《逸周書》有竘匠。
As per 占# (fixed in place) + 立 stand → *stand (rigid)*; *station*; *lodging*.
宁# stand tall/still + 立 standing figure (for emphasis/clarification) → person standing still → *stand still*. Compare 佇.
立 standing figure (doubled) → *line up*; *arrange*; *be in a row* → *rank with* → *likewise*; *and also* → *equal*; *ordinary*; *average*; *medium* (← line up).
併也。从二立。凡竝之屬皆从竝。
As per 音# (contained) + 儿 person → person whose movement is contained on reaching a distant border → *come to an end* → *finally*; *at last*.
樂曲盡爲竟。从音从人。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 辛 needle/cutting tool + an element# combining a crossing mark and a circle (= a particular pattern) → *mark*/tattoo a slave using a sharp instrument (compare 艮 and 妾) → *sentence*; *chapter*; (musical) *movement*; *counter* (for sentences, poems, regulations etc.) (← marking elements) → *rule*; *clear* (← clear rules for marking). The mark/tattoo was conceived of as rising from the skin, and "rise" is the concept most often conveyed by 章 in derivative characters. A seal inscription form alters the components to 音 and 十, these eventually morphing into 立 + 早.
樂竟爲一章。从音从十。十，數之終也。
立 (ON reading: リツ) for the sound of リ(ッ) as an abbreviated transliteration of "liter" ( リットル) + 百 one hundred → one *hectoliter*.
As per 矣# (come to a stop) + 立 stand → *wait*; *await*; *anticipate*. Compare 俟.
待也。从立矣聲。
As per 夋# as described in 俊 (stand erect) + 立 stand → stand erect → *complete*; *terminate* (← complete causing something to stand erect).
偓竣也。从立夋聲。《國語》曰：“有司巳事而竣。”

The relevant bronzeware inscription form is an element combining 東 (pierced sack) and 土 earth (suggesting the same idea found in 重 of weight thrusting heavily down upon the earth) + another element combining a needle and an eye → run through a slave-child's eye with a needle (compare 民, 敃 and 僕) → *child* (← child servant ← servant ← slave). The present form amalgamates the top two elements into 立 and the bottom two into 里.
男有辠曰奴，奴曰童，女曰妾。从䇂，重省聲。
As per 束# (compact) + 立 stand → shrink in reverence/awe → *revere*; *be in awe of* → *respect*.
敬也。从立从束。束，自申束也。
亭安也。从立爭聲。
As per 曷# (cut off) + 立 stand → stand exhausted, one's breath cut off (compare 歇) → *exhaust*; *end*.
負舉也。从立曷聲。

As per 耑# (neatly aligned) + 立 stand → stand in neat alignment. This meaning dropped, with 端 acquiring the borrowed meaning *end* via the original sense of 耑 (cloth hanging in neat alignment → the ends of a piece of cloth ) → *edge*; *tip*; *side* → *fraction*; *portion*. Also, *vicinity* (← beside; around ← side) and *rectitude* → *right*.
直也。从立耑聲。

立 (ON reading: リツ) for the sound of リ(ッ) as an abbreviated transliteration of "liter" ( リットル) + 厘. In the 尺貫法 （シャッカンホウ） measuring system Japan inherited from China 厘 represented 1/100 of a unit, so the combination of elements here creates the meaning one *centiliter*.
等也。从立專聲。《春秋國語》曰：“竱本肇末。”
北地高樓無屋者。从立曾聲。
不正也。从立𩰬聲。

The relevant seal inscription form is 誩# + 从. 誩 is 言 words (doubled) → verbal disputation. 从 is a variant form of 従 (people in close formation). The combination of elements suggests verbal competition → *compete* → *auction*.
彊語也。一曰逐也。从誩，从二人。
繇也舞也。樂有章。从章从夅从夊。《詩》曰：“竷竷舞我。”
A depiction of a pair of rigid, tubular *bamboo* stalks rising from the earth.
冬生艸也。象形。下垂者，箁箬也。凡竹之屬皆从竹。
竹# (rigid) bamboo + 二 two → *bamboo* approximately twice as *thick* as ordinary bamboo. Logically, the classifier for 竺 should be 二, but it is traditionally given as 竹.
厚也。从二竹聲。
As per 于# (U-shaped) + 竹 bamboo → *ancient musical instrument* constructed of curved pieces of bamboo arranged in a U-shape.
管三十六簧也。从竹亏聲。
干# thick bar + 竹 bamboo → *bamboo pole* → *pole*. Also, *neck* of a violin or shamisen.
竹梃也。从竹干聲。
